title: Avatar Show: live steering, notes, recording and a proper panel
description: Talk to the cast mid-show without breaking it: real-time voice notes to one character in her own voice, audience notes the whole cast follows, pause and resume, MP4 recording, a movable panel window and the bubble theme throughout.
highlights: Press a character's mic during a show for a private note through gpt-live-1: she listens live in her own voice, acknowledges in one sentence, applies it from her next line, and the show carries on.
Call out a note for the whole cast and the show holds, the Director answers, and every later line follows it; say “continue” to resume. Pause, Resume and Stop live in the panel header.
Record to MP4: the performance is saved to Movies › GPT-Live Avatar Shows with captions and every voice mixed in, whenever it finishes or is stopped.
The Avatar Show panel is the window: traffic lights, drag, resize, remembered position; the stage stays transparent. The panel, prompter and bubble share one design, light and dark.

Fixes: the prompter's buttons take real clicks; the Director voice hangs up while the Playwright writes (no idle session cost); resting characters shift stance at their own pace; a put-away prop no longer leaves a weapon grip; scripted lines show in the bubble the moment they start.
